name: Trusts Issuer
description: An AWS IAM OIDC provider registers trust in an OIDC issuer — its configured URL is that issuer's host. Derived link resolved during the github_core enrichment phase by matching aws_iam_oidc_provider.url against oidc_issuer.host; converges the AWS federation path onto the same issuer node Sigstore identities are vouched by. Derived link — not hotlink-backed (the provider is written by aws_core, which does not emit this edge).
